_meta.name: Football Agent AI Operating System
_meta.description: Centralized FIFA football agency hub: tracks player contracts, matches club squad needs across Asian and European transfer markets, generates tactical scouting dossiers, and automates club pitch outreach.

nodes.name: Player & Market Ingest
nodes.subtitle: Transfermarkt & Scouting Ingest
nodes.description: Ingests player profile, tactical metrics, current club contract, and agent representation data.

nodes.name: Contract & Salary Matrix
nodes.subtitle: Expiry & Compensation Valuation
nodes.description: Evaluates expiration timeline, wage expectations across Asian markets (Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, India) vs Europe/Spain, and agent commissions.

nodes.name: Club Squad Need Matcher
nodes.subtitle: Tactical & Budget Matching Engine
nodes.description: Matches player's tactical profile and salary demands against target clubs' open squad requirements, coach preferences, and foreign quota limits.

nodes.name: Dossier & Pitch Generator
nodes.subtitle: Claude Executive Dossier & Outreach
nodes.description: Generates professional player presentation dossiers, club pitch emails, and personalized WhatsApp messages for sporting directors.

nodes.name: Action Center Sign-Off
nodes.subtitle: FIFA Agent Approval Gate
nodes.description: Stages deal outreach in Action Center for agent one-click sign-off before dispatching to sporting directors.
